title: Small Compiler Subset Semantic Resolver Independence
purpose: Give the BSharp Compiler Subset 0 path its own semantic resolver implementation while preserving the production Ruby SemanticResolver only as a separate referee for deterministic parity.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_semantic_resolver.rb as the independent subset semantic resolver
routing SmallCompilerSubsetIREmitter document generation through SmallCompilerSubsetSemanticResolver
using compiler/resolver.rb only on the separate Ruby referee path
requiring exact BSharp IR parity against the production Ruby SemanticResolver
proving v0.1.73 open close lock and take object interaction through the independent subset semantic resolver
preserving Profiles 1 through 7, existing bytecode formats, runtime meaning, Save, ASK, input devices, and production compiler routing
forbidden_until_later_approval: routing normal BASIC# production compilation through the subset semantic resolver
adding new creator-facing syntax or changing runtime meaning

acceptance_rules: SmallCompilerSubsetIREmitter must create its primary BSharp IR document with SmallCompilerSubsetSemanticResolver.
The independent resolver must not call or require the production SemanticResolver implementation.
Each accepted fixture must match production Ruby Parser plus SemanticResolver BSharp IR exactly.
The production SemanticResolver may remain loaded for referee comparison but cannot be required by the independent resolver file.
Object interaction open close lock and take must canonicalize identically through the independent resolver and Ruby referee.
The semantic resolver independence tool must be present in the sealed Trial-by-Fire validation inventory.
No full self-hosting or Ruby retirement claim is permitted in v0.1.77.
